summary: Updated BoostNet 2.0 Master Implementation Plan preserving 100% of all existing text and concepts, with the 5 critical engineering additions: Cellular DNS resolution via cellularNetwork.getAllByName, Windows SoftAP offline bootstrap, Public Suffix List (PSL) domain hashing, Browser Extension loopback IPC with Cookie/Header handoff, and GET Range 0-0 probe fallback for HEAD rejections.
